comments.post_title: IELTS Speaking Part 1: short, simple answers
comments.text:
: Hi Sonia,

I understand the pain of not succeeding IELTS. The main trick in writing is to concentrate on the question given, not to cross the boundaries. Answer specifically and Concisely.

Do not opt for uncommon or tough words, instead keep it simple and clear to the point.
